findings.result: Both Rust diffs are additions only. Existing nearest_rank, microsecond distributions, confidence intervals, validation and replay exit behavior remain byte-for-byte unchanged. New legacy_latency_ns sorts exact u64 durations and calls the existing nearest_rank implementation; no conversion through microseconds or floating-point durations occurs.

The Rust replay validates rows before computing finished_ns-offered_ns. New legacy_ns filters by operation only, preserving success/error/canceled/queue_rejected. Empty operation subsets retain n=0 and null quantiles; an empty plan remains rejected.

The old active Python latency_summary implementation and its math import are removed. Existing replay_statistics is unchanged. The driver reads statistics.json once for this copy, checks SHA256 of those exact bytes against statistics_result.sha256, parses those same bytes, and copies the Rust-owned legacy_ns wire fields. No fallback or second quantile implementation is added.

Existing report latency and latency_by_operation field shape, integer nanosecond precision, empty nulls, scope and tail_stability_claim remain. The Rust replay adds legacy_ns while retaining existing microsecond layers. The independent statistics reference API is unchanged.

Two statistics Rust tests cover empty/single/u64::MAX/submicrosecond and nearest-rank boundaries. Two actual-replay Rust tests cover every terminal status, read/build/all, original nanosecond precision, old microsecond behavior, deterministic input ordering and empty-operation behavior. Python controls prove exact sentinel wire copying and rejection after statistics bytes are altered following verification; synthetic data is explicitly marked, not treated as measured evidence.

The final test blob 797dda75 restores the original success60 outcomes assertion to test_equal_oracle_retains_successful_observation. The displaced assertion in v3 e5129b is not accepted. The original direct Python algorithm test is replaced by the Rust replay denominator tests, rather than retaining two algorithm owners.

Only the explanatory ownership paragraph changes in P8_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE.md. It preserves the ns wire / microsecond-layer distinction and does not claim tests, CI, measurements or task completion have passed.
